sources.entry: Smotrite - Smotrite is a system monitor for macOS, which just work.

summary.one_liner: Smotrite is an early-alpha macOS system monitor meant as an alternative to Activity Monitor, with drag-and-drop widgets and a mini view.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Smotrite as a "better Activity Monitor alternative for macOS." It mentions widgets that can be dragged and dropped, a fancy frame, and a mini view. The author says the app is currently alpha and contains mostly design plus a few basic widgets. The README does not list specific metrics, install steps, or supported macOS versions. The Todo list names only refactoring and i18n (internationalization). The author invites contributions.
use_cases: experimenting with a SwiftUI-style macOS utility
notable: Fancy frame with a mini view mode
Positioned as a Better Activity Monitor alternative
caveats: Early alpha; the author says it has only design and a few basic widgets with poor code
No install or run instructions in the README
Todo lists refactoring and i18n as still pending
keywords: see what is using my cpu
